Added: Right-click a JSON/YAML file in the file tree and choose "Import as OpenAPI Collection..." — reads the file directly and opens the same preview/import overlay, no need to open it as a tab first and find the small action-bar icon

src/skill.md — teaches an agent how to generate .void files directly from a raw OpenAPI document, including CRUD-consolidation guidance, the auth mapping the deterministic importer doesn't generate at all (security schemes → Voiden auth blocks), and the openapispecLink block that enables live response validation against the spec
Fixed: The import button's file-detection check matched the bare word "openapi" anywhere in a file — a false positive on any file whose description/name/comment merely mentions "OpenAPI" without the document actually being one. Now requires the real field-assignment shape (openapi: 3.x) and excludes files that also carry another tool's own format marker (Postman, Bruno, Insomnia), since those legitimately embed a linked OpenAPI spec without being one themselves
OpenAPI preview overlay now mounts inside the editor area instead of document.body, eliminating z-index conflicts with the sidebar, APYHub Explorer, and right-click context menus
Preview no longer appears in front of explorer panels or swallows context menu interactions
OpenAPI file-format detection now scans only the first 64KB of a tab's content instead of the full buffer, so it no longer rescans the entire file on every render for large specs
Generated .void files now correctly link to the OpenAPI spec file
Validation pipeline now correctly resolves project context and spec file paths
Correct request body block is now generated for each content type — JSON, XML, YAML, multipart form, and binary instead of defaulting to JSON for every request
All text and border colors now use standard Voiden theme variables throughout the preview panel
API title no longer overlaps the OpenAPI Preview top bar
Panel height correctly contained within overlay — no overflow outside container
Generate Voiden Files button pinned to bottom of panel at all times
Removed catch-all shim so js-yaml bundles inline correctly
OpenAPI 3.1 schema support and anyOf / oneOf / allOf schema merging
Circular $ref references no longer cause infinite loops
YAML files with custom anchors now import correctly
